description: The wind turbine generators will be arranged in a 0.93- by 0.75-nautical-mile offset grid pattern (east–west by northwest by southeast gridded layout)
context_quote: Dominion would space WTGs in a 0.93- by 0.75-nautical-mile offset grid pattern (east–west by northwest by southeast gridded layout).

description: The wind turbine generators will range from 14 MW to 16 MW in capacity
context_quote: an up-to 3,000 MW wind energy facility consisting of up to 202 WTGs ranging from 14 MW to 16 MW each

description: The maximum number of wind turbine generators is 202
context_quote: an up-to 3,000 MW wind energy facility consisting of up to 202 WTGs ranging from 14 MW to 16 MW each

description: The number of offshore substations is limited to three
context_quote: and three OSSs in the Lease Area and associated export cables would occur offshore Virginia

description: The offshore substations will be placed within the rows of the gridded wind turbine generator layout
context_quote: The three OSSs would be placed within the rows of the gridded WTG layout.

description: The inter-array cables will connect the individual wind turbine generators to the offshore substations
context_quote: inter-array cables linking the individual WTGs

description: Up to nine export cables will make landfall in Virginia Beach, Virginia
context_quote: Up to nine export cables make landfall in Virginia Beach, Virginia.

description: The onshore export cables will transfer electricity from the cable landing location to a switching station constructed north of Harpers Road in Virginia Beach, Virginia
context_quote: Onshore export cables would transfer electricity from the cable landing location to a switching station constructed north of Harpers Road in Virginia Beach, Virginia.

description: An overhead interconnection cable route will connect the Harpers Switching Station to the Fentress Substation located in Chesapeake, Virginia
context_quote: An overhead interconnection cable route would then connect the new Harpers Switching Station to the Fentress Substation located in Chesapeake, Virginia.

description: Wind turbine generators, offshore substations, and inter-array cables can be microsited up to 500 feet to avoid sensitive cultural resources and marine habitats
context_quote: This configuration would still allow micrositing of WTGs (up to 500 feet) to avoid sensitive cultural resources and marine habitats.

description: The Fish Haven area along the northern boundary of the Lease Area will be an exclusion zone where no wind turbine generators or associated infrastructure will be developed
geographic_scope: Northern boundary of Lease Area OCS-A 0483
context_quote: the Fish Haven area located along the northern boundary of the Lease Area would be an exclusion zone (e.g., eight WTGs and associated infrastructure would not be developed or placed in the Fish Haven area).

description: Three wind turbine generators and associated inter-array cables will be excluded from the northwest corner of the Lease Area to avoid a proposed vessel traffic fairway
geographic_scope: Northwest corner of Lease Area OCS-A 0483
context_quote: Additionally, three WTGs and associated inter-array cables would be excluded from the northwest corner of the Lease Area to avoid a proposed vessel traffic fairway.

description: Four wind turbine generators within priority sand ridge habitat will be removed, and one wind turbine generator will be relocated to minimize impacts on sand ridge habitat
geographic_scope: Areas of priority sand ridge habitat within Lease Area OCS-A 0483
context_quote: the removal of four WTGs within priority sand ridge habitat, and the relocation of one WTG.

description: The onshore interconnection cable route will either follow Interconnection Cable Route Option 1 (entirely overhead) or Interconnection Cable Route Option 6 (hybrid of underground and overhead) to minimize impacts on onshore sensitive habitats
context_quote: Unlike Alternatives A, B, and C, the construction of interconnection cables under Alternative D would follow either Interconnection Cable Route Option 1 or Interconnection Cable Route Option 6 (Hybrid Route), as described in the COP (Dominion Energy 2023). For purposes of comparative analyses, Interconnection Cable Route Option 1 will be evaluated in all action alternatives. However, under Alternative D, BOEM considered either Interconnection Cable Route Option 1 or 6 (Hybrid Route) to minimize impacts of the proposed Project on onshore sensitive habitats.

description: Project vessels must not exceed a speed of 10 knots within the Block Island Sound Transit Lane
context_quote: To protect sensitive habitats, vessel speeds for all project vessels shall not exceed 10 knots within the Block Island Sound Transit Lane.

description: Cable trenching is prohibited within 500 meters of the identified historic shipwreck (No. 551B)
geographic_scope: Area within 500 meters of historic shipwreck (No. 551B)
context_quote: Furthermore, trenching activities are prohibited within 500 meters of the identified historic shipwreck (No. 551B) at all times.
